title: The Brave Little Explorer
cover: Once upon a time, a little explorer set out to find the Golden Sunflower at the top of Giggle Mountain...

chapters.title: Waking Up
chapters.narration: The sun peeks over the hills. Our explorer stretches tall and yawns. Time to warm up those sleepy muscles!

chapters.title: Into the Forest
chapters.narration: Into the whispering forest we go, past friendly animals who show us how they move.

chapters.title: Crossing the River
chapters.narration: A wobbly log bridge crosses the river. Steady now — balance is the secret to getting across!

chapters.title: Climbing the Mountain
chapters.narration: Up, up, up the mountain! Bend and twist around the giant rainbow rocks.

chapters.title: The Golden Sunflower
chapters.narration: We made it to the top! Time for a calm, happy rest beside the Golden Sunflower. You did it, explorer!

title: Under the Sea Quest
cover: Splash! Dive down to the coral castle and help the Sea King find his lost pearl crown...

chapters.title: The Big Dive
chapters.narration: Take a giant breath and dive under the shimmering waves. Wiggle like a fish!

chapters.title: The Coral Garden
chapters.narration: Swim through the swaying coral. Stretch long and fold like the ocean plants.

chapters.title: The Swirly Current
chapters.narration: A twisty current spins you round and round. Twist with it and stay strong!

chapters.title: The Pearl Crown
chapters.narration: You found the pearl crown in the coral castle! Float gently and rest, brave sea hero.

title: Space Blast-Off
cover: 3... 2... 1... BLAST OFF! Journey past the moon and stars to plant a flag on Planet Wobble...

chapters.title: Countdown
chapters.narration: The rocket is ready! Shake out the wiggles and power up your engines.

chapters.title: Zero Gravity
chapters.narration: In space you float and tumble! Find your balance among the floating stars.

chapters.title: Moon Walk
chapters.narration: Bounce across the moon in giant, strong steps. Stand mighty like a space hero!

chapters.title: Planet Wobble
chapters.narration: You planted your flag on Planet Wobble! Drift home and rest among the twinkling stars.
